description: Seed v1 (unchanged) plus sourced additions for U3 part 2. v1 items keep available_at = when this project fetched and checked each source (14-15 Nov 2026). Added items are dated by evidence of earlier public availability: an Internet Archive snapshot that contains the statement (date_basis retrieved, available_at = the snapshot timestamp), or a document that prints its own date (date_basis published, available_at = noon UTC the day after that date); otherwise the fetch instant on 2026-11-24. Coordinates are approximate city, district or port centroids from general geographic reference, not from the cited documents. Confidence conventions: operates 1.0 when the company lists the site as its own, 0.9 when the same source says a majority-owned subsidiary runs it, 0.5 for a joint venture; ships_through 0.8 when the company says its own vessels or earnings were directly affected by the passage. Companies without a sourced listing are left unlisted.
